summary.content:
Today's selection covers 95 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 51 on Artificial Intelligence and 20 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Orange Business Reimagines Enterprise Voice Communications With Trust and AI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: New ‘LucidRook’ malware used in targeted attacks on NGOs, universities
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, The Verge, BBC Technology, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 48 articles published in the last 24 hours
